title: Trial Sample Terms of the Urological Supply Program
content:
A prospective or enrolled patient of the Urological Supply Program may receive a free sample of the program's sample size in catheters of a program's catheter, at most the program's annual count of sample shipments per calendar year. A sample is never billed to coverage and never counts toward a monthly limit. Samples go only to an enrollment that is enrolled-pending or active.

## How the annual count is taken

The count is the number of sample shipments on the patient's enrollments whose ship date falls in the calendar year of the handling date. Samples shipped in an earlier calendar year are not counted.

## Enrollment status

| Status of the enrollment | A sample may go to it |
|---|---|
| enrolled-pending | yes |
| active | yes |
| on hold | no |
| cancelled | no |

The evidence is the enrollment's status on the system record.

## Hypothetical cases

- A patient on the Straight Intermittent Catheter Program (A4351), annual count 2, has two sample shipments dated in the current calendar year: the annual count is reached and no further sample ships this year.
- The same patient's two samples were both shipped in the previous calendar year: the count for the current year is 0.
- A sample of catheters sent to an active enrollment is not billed to coverage and leaves the month's catheter allowance unchanged.
